description: This file defines classes and functions related to interceptable network requests in WebKit within the Playwright project, including request handling, response creation, and request interception.

classes.name: WKInterceptableRequest
classes.description: Represents an interceptable network request in WebKit, capable of creating responses and adopting requests from new processes.

classes.name: WKRouteImpl
classes.description: Implements network route delegate for intercepting, fulfilling, and continuing requests in WebKit.

methods.name: adoptRequestFromNewProcess
methods.description: Adopts the request from a new WKSession, updating internal request ID.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a network.Response object from the response payload, fetching response body asynchronously.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the request with a specified error code.

methods.name: fulfill
methods.description: Fulfills the request with a specified response, including status, headers, and body.

methods.name: continue
methods.description: Continues the request with optional overrides such as URL, method, headers, and postData.
